---
title: "Review and approve combined CVD metrics"
description: "Step 5: prepare disclosure-review evidence and record approval."
date-modified: 2026-08-28
---

## Prepare

```stata
do "$BNR_STATA/monthly/bnr_step5_review.do" 2024 4 prepare
```

This reads `$BNR_STAGING/metrics/cvd/cvd_2024_04/` and writes private review
evidence to its `review/` folder. Use `prepare replace` only to deliberately
rebuild the review state.

Review, at minimum:

- `step5_review.xlsx` — human review guide;
- `step5_disclosure_qa.csv` — every row must be `PASS`;
- `step5_equation_audit.csv` — annual count/rate representation closure;
- `step5_row_audit.dta` — protection propagation and numeric blanking; and
- `step5_review_basis.csv` — fingerprints of the reviewed evidence.

For annual DCO counts, check that the review records the protected identity
`hospital only + additional DCO = hospital plus DCO`. Do not edit generated
evidence, candidates or workbooks manually; correct code or input, rerun and
review again.

## Approve

After an authorised BNR Lead, BNR Analyst or BNR Developer has completed the
review, run:

```stata
do "$BNR_STATA/monthly/bnr_step5_review.do" 2024 4 approve "Full name" "BNR Developer"
```

Approval rechecks the review fingerprints and QA, then writes the private
`public_ready/` package, `public_manifest.csv` and `approval.yml`. It does not
publish. Use `replace` only for a deliberate re-approval of the same release.

The public-ready candidate must not contain private linkage, component,
allocation or suppression-decision fields. Protected rows remain in the public
dataset with blank numeric fields and `display_value: *`.
